# zion-minecraft-agents

A plug-and-play AI mod builder for Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.4 (Forge 54.x).
Designed for a 5-year-old: one text input, one button, mod installs automatically.

## What It Does

Converts natural language requests ("add a fire dragon boss") into:
1. Compiled Forge mods (Java) or JSON datapacks
2. Automatic installation to the Minecraft server
3. Server restart — Zion joins and plays immediately

## Agent Pipeline

- `agents/orchestrator.md` — Routes requests, never asks clarifying questions
- `agents/mod-agent.md` — Builds Java Forge 1.21.4 mods (mobs, items, blocks, armor)
- `agents/world-builder.md` — Builds JSON datapacks (biomes, structures, loot tables)
- `agents/lore-agent.md` — Writes quests, NPC dialogue, written books
- `agents/deploy-agent.md` — Installs files, backs up, restarts server

## UI

Python stdlib HTTP server (`ui/server.py`) + single HTML file (`ui/index.html`).
No npm, no pip, no build step. Launched via double-click `.command` file.

## Stack

- Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.4
- Forge 54.x
- Java 21 + Gradle 8.x
- Python 3 (stdlib only)
- Claude Code CLI

## Server

Default path: `/Users/justin/minecraft-server`
Configurable in `CLAUDE.md` and `agents/deploy-agent.md`.

## Rules

1. Never ask the user (Zion) a question — make a creative decision and proceed
2. Always back up `/mods` before any deploy
3. Always restart the server after installing
4. If deploy fails, restore backup and restart anyway
5. Keep everything kid-friendly

## AGI-1 Framework

Self-healing: `.claude/healing/patterns/` logs error→fix patterns.
Self-learning: `.claude/learning/observations.json` auto-logs failures via hooks.
Genome: `~/.claude/agi-1-genome/genome.json` accumulates patterns across repos.
Session orchestrator: `/agi-main` gives repo health brief and routing.
